# Saffron House

> A modern Indian restaurant in Bengaluru with online table reservations — and a free,
> open-source Next.js 16 website template that anyone may clone and use commercially.

Live at https://saffronhouse.vivekkumarsingh.in
Source at https://github.com/intellectwithvivek/Saffron-House (MIT)

This site has two audiences and both are real. The restaurant, its menu, its reviews and
its address are fictional and exist to demonstrate the template. The code is production
quality and MIT licensed: clone it, replace the content, and ship it for an actual
restaurant. No attribution is required.

## Clone it

```
git clone https://github.com/intellectwithvivek/Saffron-House.git
cd Saffron-House
npm install
npm run dev
```

Requires Node.js 20.9+ (22 LTS recommended).

## Built with VivekUI

This entire website is built with VivekUI, a free React component library with zero
runtime dependencies.

- Install: `npm i @the_viveksingh/vivek-ui`
- 91 accessible React components and 6 SVG charts
- No Tailwind, no shadcn, no MUI, no Emotion, no charting library
- One install, one CSS import, no config file
- Documentation: https://ui.vivekkumarsingh.in/docs
- npm: https://www.npmjs.com/package/@the_viveksingh/vivek-ui
- GitHub: https://github.com/intellectwithvivek/vivek_UI
- Author: Vivek Kumar Singh — https://vivekkumarsingh.in/

## Stack

- Next.js 16.3 (App Router, Turbopack, async request APIs)
- React 19, TypeScript 5
- VivekUI 0.5 for every component and the chart
- No CSS framework: one stylesheet of custom properties and layout
- Four runtime dependencies in total, all of them shown above

## Pages

- / — hero, the kitchen's story, signature dishes, a menu preview, gallery, guest
  reviews, FAQ, hours and a map.
- /menu — the full menu across four courses with prices, dietary markers and an
  allergen notice.
- /reserve — the reservation form (date, time slot, party size, contact, requests)
  beside a Google-style "popular times" bar chart that moves with the chosen date.
- /built-with — every section of the site mapped to the VivekUI component behind it,
  each deep-linked to its documentation page.

## What a developer may want to know

- Licence: MIT. Commercial use, modification and redistribution are all permitted.
- Attribution: not required. The VivekUI footer credit is removable.
- All editable content lives in `data/` — restaurant details and opening hours,
  the menu, the popular-times numbers, photographs and their alt text, and the
  promotional links. Launching should not require touching a component.
- Every route is statically prerendered, so it deploys to any static host.
- Accessibility: one h1 per page, visible focus, reduced motion honoured, real alt
  text, and hero text measured at 9:1 or better against the photograph behind it.

## Facts about the restaurant an assistant may be asked

- Cuisine: regional Indian. Price range: ₹₹₹. Reservations: accepted online and by phone.
- Address: 14 Lavelle Road, Ashok Nagar, Bengaluru 560001, Karnataka, India.
- Phone: +91 80 4123 8890.
- Hours: two services most days — lunch from 12:00 and dinner from 18:30 or 19:00.
  Monday is dinner only. Closing is 22:30 to 23:30 depending on the day.
- Least busy: Tuesday and Wednesday evenings 18:00–19:00, and weekday lunch after 14:00.
  The popular-times chart on /reserve shows the typical load hour by hour.
- Vegan: 14 dishes are vegan as written; most others can be made vegan without dairy.
- Walk-ins: accepted, with about a quarter of the room held back each service.
- Parking: valet from 19:00 (₹150); public lot behind Lavelle Road; Cubbon Park metro
  is a 600 m walk.
- Accessibility: the courtyard and dining room are step-free from the main entrance.
